name: dw2-xml-patch
description: Select a line in a Distant Worlds 2 data file and add a patch for it to your mod's patches folder (DW2 Mod Launcher XML patching).

commands.title: DW2: Patch this… (choose what to do)
DW2: Choose the mod folder for patches

dw2Patch.modFolder.markdownDescription: The mod folder (the one with `mod.json`) whose `patches` folder receives the patches. Leave empty to find it in the workspace: a folder with `mod.json` or `dw2modlauncher.json`, at the workspace root or one level below.

dw2Patch.patchFile.markdownDescription: Write every patch to this one file, relative to the mod folder (for example `patches/my-tweaks.xml`). Leave empty to use `patches/<name of the data file>`, so patches for `Races.xml` go to `patches/Races.xml`. A file only takes patches for one data file, so a fixed name suits a mod that only touches one.

dw2Patch.indent.markdownDescription: One level of indentation in patch files you create or add to (two spaces by default; use `\t` for a tab).
